title: Residuated lattice
description: JSON Schema for a bounded integral commutative residuated lattice as data: a lattice ⟨L, ⊓, ⊔, ⊥, ⊤⟩ extended with a binary fusion operation ⊗ and its right residual →, where ⊗ is commutative monoidal with unit = ⊤. The residuation law a ⊗ b ≤ c iff a ≤ b → c and the monoidal axioms are not expressible in JSON Schema and must be checked by a verifier.

carrier.description: The underlying set L as a finite array of distinct symbolic values.

top.description: Lattice top ⊤. Equal to the fusion unit for integrality.

fusion.description: ⊗ : L × L → L; fusion[a][b] is a ⊗ b. Commutative monoidal with unit = top.

right-residual.description: → : L × L → L; right-residual[a][b] is a → b. Adjoint to fusion: a ⊗ b ≤ c iff a ≤ b → c.

unit.description: Monoidal unit of fusion. Integrality requires unit == top.
